correctness.rationale: For H d-regular balanced bipartite, C4-free, n≥d+2, the input G is its K_{n,n} CROSS-EDGE complement, not graph complement. Any mixed independent set corresponds to complete bipartite incidence in H, hence one side singleton (C4-free), and maximality forces a centered star of size d+1; other maximal sets are U,V size n. Conditional on first accepted u in U, the next feasible vertex is one of n+d−1: probability d/(n+d−1) of opposite-class star; d(d−1) same-class choices share unique neighbor v, which beats n−d outside U vertices with probability 1/(n−d+1). Sum p=dn/((n+d−1)(n−d+1)). Per-atom probability p/(2n) for d≥2; for d=1 each matching pair has 1/n². Counting neighbors without 4-cycles gives n≥1+d(d−1), so d=O(sqrt n), p~d/n and Var(X)~dn uniformly. Projective-plane incidence H attains limiting n^(3/2) variance coefficient one along prime-power orders. Independent exhaustive 8! order calculation for H=C8, n=4,d=2 yielded p=8/15 and each of 8 star atoms 1/15; n=3,d=1 yielded each of 3 matched-pair atoms 1/9.
